blurb: Captain Jonathan Moss, a U.S. Coast Guard Licensed Captain, guides freshwater and saltwater fishing trips in Central Florida. Trips focus on putting clients on fish and teaching fishing techniques for all skill levels. The fleet includes a Cayo 180 Skiff for 2-3 anglers and a Pro Line 22 Bay Boat for up to 6 anglers.
extraNote: Prices based on 1 to 2 anglers; each additional angler is $50 plus credit card fees
